summary: Orla Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release regarding an illegal work stoppage and blockade at its Camino Rojo mine in Mexico. The filing describes a meeting with the union and Mexican labour authorities, where the blockade was deemed illegal and the union leadership committed to lifting it. Negotiations on productivity bonuses are to resume contingent on restored operations. Orla states it will take additional steps if the blockade continues. This is an operational update, not a special situation. No financial terms, deal structure, or strategic event are present.
